verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

verses.translation: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
And indeed, he is to that a witness.
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.transliteration: Wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

verses.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.translation: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.transliteration: Afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

verses.translation: And that within the breasts is obtained,
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer
